subject: science
passage: Hummingbirds feed on flower nectar, which is mostly sugar dissolved in water. To learn which sugar mixture ruby-throated hummingbirds prefer, biologist Nadia Kowalczyk hung four feeders in a garden in Ontario, Canada, each filled with a different mixture, and counted the birds' visits over one week. The feeder that received the most visits held a mixture that was ______

data.title: Hummingbird Visits to Four Feeders over One Week

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?

choices.C: taken from wild flowers, which received the most visits.

explanation.why: The statement asks which mixture was in the feeder with the most visits, so find the largest number in the "Visits" column. That number is 211, in the 20% row.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The 30% feeder received 167 visits; the 211 visits belong to the 20% feeder, so this misreads the table.
explanation.B: Correct. The 20% feeder received 211 visits, the largest number in the "Visits" column.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The table lists only sugar mixtures in feeders; it gives no data about wild flower nectar.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The 10% feeder received the fewest visits, not the most.
